filter countData by gene expression, perform cpm and log2(cpm+1) transformation

Source: R/ngs_rnaseq.R
filter_calcpm_dge.Rd

filter countData by gene expression, perform cpm and log2(cpm+1) transformation

Usage

filter_calcpm_dge(count_df, group = NULL, min_count = 10, min_prop = 0.1)

Arguments

count_df

a data.frame of count data, rows are genes and columns are samples

group

a vector of group information, default is NULL, every sample is in the same group

min_count

minimum count for a gene to be kept, default is 10

min_prop

minimum proportion of samples in the smallest group to have the minimum count, default is 0.1

Value

a list of edgeR objects, including dge_count, dge_cpm, dge_keep, dge_keep_cpm, dge_keep_cpm_log

Examples

filter_calcpm_dge(count_df)
